basis_statement: Identity, location, delivery, route continuity, and storage backing remain separate contract families; no later package may collapse them into one undifferentiated string vocabulary.

source_lineage.rationale: The data model publishes widespread `*_id`, `*_ref`, `*_hash`, `storage_ref`, and target-ref vocabulary that must stay coherent.
Evidence lineage already distinguishes raw payload and content refs from human-readable labels.

source_lineage.source_heading_or_logical_block: target_ref, root_ref, and path traversal semantics
source_lineage.rationale: Provenance traversal requires durable reference families that are not confused with delivery or route state.

source_lineage.source_heading_or_logical_block: Current-vs-history artifact selection and delivery-binding safety
source_lineage.rationale: Preview, download, and print defaults must reflect the current artifact without leaking raw storage paths.

source_lineage.source_heading_or_logical_block: Route identity and delivery binding in cache envelopes
source_lineage.rationale: Cache partitions and route identity must stay distinct from durable artifact truth.
A resumable upload can keep the same `storage_ref` while request-version truth changes, which requires a separate storage namespace family.

family_rows.semantic_role: Stable workflow or business identity used for joins, receipts, and replay anchors.
notes: An ID may be rendered in URLs or logs only if the surrounding contract already allows it.
IDs do not imply object location, delivery affordance, or previewability.

family_rows.semantic_role: Durable lineage, object, or content pointer resolved through control truth and provenance law.
notes: Generic `*_ref` remains lawful only when no more specific family applies.
A durable ref can survive copy-on-publish while downstream target refs change.

family_rows.semantic_role: Canonical integrity, cache, or security-binding digest computed over stable input.
notes: Hashes prove canonical context; they do not identify the business object on their own.
Hash input must remain deterministic and side-effect free.

family_rows.semantic_role: Durable preview, print, governance, or current-download target selection for a specific experience surface.
notes: A target ref tells the product which lawful derivative to show; it never smuggles credentials.
Current defaults come from explicit target families and never from a storage handle.

family_rows.semantic_role: Opaque internal object-storage backing handle aligned to bucket purpose and upload continuity law.
notes: Storage refs survive resume and reconnect, including request-version drift, without becoming customer-facing truth.
A storage ref must not expose bucket names, provider credentials, or signed URL parameters.

family_rows.semantic_role: Customer or external handoff handle bound to invocation-time route, access, masking, and target context.
lawful_examples: current artifact download handle plus binding hash
notes: Delivery uses both an opaque ref and a context hash; neither piece authorizes broad reuse alone.
Signed URLs, bearer tokens, and raw storage paths are explicitly forbidden content.

family_rows.semantic_role: Shell continuity or scene token used for restoration, cache partitioning, and lawful same-object return.
notes: Route tokens may describe patterns or scene keys but may not be full URLs.
Route state is a continuity aid, not durable artifact identity.
